item.createTitle: Create default template and open in editor

global.title: Global memory
global.hint: Automatically read by ZCode sessions in all projects

project.title: Project memory
project.hint: Automatically read only by ZCode sessions in the current project

auto.title: ZCode auto memory
auto.hint: Automatically distilled from completed conversations and injected into later sessions (toggle shared with the ZCode client)
auto.switchDesc: Save and reuse long-term context in this workspace; takes effect for new sessions. Shares the same toggle with the ZCode client settings; enabling it may increase model calls and token usage
auto.switchOnHint: Click to turn off (applies to new sessions)
auto.switchOffHint: Click to turn on (applies to new sessions)
auto.indexDesc: Memory index (one line per memory, pointing to fact files in the same directory)
auto.factFallback: Facts automatically distilled from completed conversations
auto.empty: No auto memories yet — turn on the toggle above and finish a few conversations; distilled facts will appear here
auto.dirMissHint: Reading location derived from the current project path. If directories in the memories root end with a different 16-char hash, the memories were written under another path — open the root to compare
auto.revealDirTitle: Reveal this folder in the system file manager
auto.revealRootTitle: Open the memories root in the system file manager (compare project directory names)
